sentences.text: 如果那天他多练了一遍，比赛结果可能就不同了。
sentences.answer: If he had practised once more that day, the result might have been different.
sentences.note: 与过去事实相反：从句 had done，主句 might have done。

sentences.text: 他迟到的消息让大家都很意外。
sentences.answer: The news that he was late surprised everyone.
sentences.note: that 从句说明 news 的具体内容，不作成分。

sentences.text: 你练得越多，进步就越快。
sentences.answer: The more you practise, the faster you will improve.
sentences.note: 两个分句都用陈述语序，只把比较级提前。

sentences.text: If I had known the rule earlier, I would not have made that mistake.
sentences.answer: 如果我早点知道这条规则，就不会犯那个错误了。
sentences.note: 与过去事实相反：had known / would not have made。

sentences.text: The idea that practice matters more than talent is widely accepted.
sentences.answer: 练习比天赋更重要这一观点已被广泛接受。
sentences.note: that 从句说明 idea 的具体内容。
